CARDINAL FINANCIAL COMPANY. LIMITED PARTNERSHIP, is the Plaintiff, and MARIA ELENA DROUET. ET ALS., are Defendants, writ of execution for the sale of mortgaged premises dated 9/24/2025.
By virtue of the above stated Writ, to me directed and delivered. I wIll expose to sale at public vendue on WEDNESDAY. the 21ST DAY of JANUARY A.D. 2026, at the hour of one thIrty o' clock by the then prevaIIIng (Standard or DayLight Saving) time, in the afternoon of the said day, at the Heldrich Hotel, 1O LIvingston Ave, New Brunswick, N.J. 08901
The property to be sold is located In the TOWNSHIP OF WOODBRIDGE, County of Middlesex and State of New Jersey
Premises commonly known as: 640 FAIRVIEW AVENUE
COLONIA. NJ 07067
Tax Lot: 540, Tax Block: 424.Q4 Dimensions: 54.O FT.
X 125.OFT. Nearest Cross Street : UNION STREET
THE SHERIFF HEREBY RESERVES THE RIGHT TO ADJOURN THIS SALE WITHOUT FURTHER NOTICE BY PUBLICATION.
The occupancy status to the property ls: OCCUPIED BY UNKNOWN. Plaintiff's good faIth estimate oF its upset price is: $394,464.04
The Final Judgment and Writ of ExecutIon were assigned from Cardinal Financial Company, LimIted Partnership to Freedom Mortgage Corporation dated August 19, 2025, and filed in the Superior Court oF New Jersey on September 2, 2025. THE PURCHASER AT THE SALE SHALL BE ENTITLED ONLY TO A RETURN OF THE DEPOSIT PAID. THE PURCHASER SHALL HAVE NO FURTHER RECOURSE AGAINST THE MORTGAGOR. THE MORTGAGEE OR THE MORTGAGEE'S ATTORNEY.
SURPLUS MONEY: IF after the sale and satisfaction oF the mortgage debt, IncludIng costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited Into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent oF that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have Information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount of the upset to be satisfied by said sale is the sum of THREE HUNDRED FIFTEEN THOUSAND FIVE HUNDRED SEVENTY ONE DOLLARS AND NINETY CENTS ($315,571 .9O) dollars more or less, plus Interest together with the costs of this sale. THE UPSET AMOUNT MAY BE SUBJECT TO FURTHER ORDERS OF ADDITIONAL SUMS.

SuccessFul bidder must pay 20% of bid in cash (UP to $1,000.00), certified check or official bank check at close of sale and the balance in two weeks.
